import resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
for mode in ['backlog','drain','branches','sampling']:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,'bench.py',mode], check=True, capture_output=True)
    data = open('/tmp/bench_in.json','rb').read()
    t0=time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/cli.py'], stdin=open('/tmp/bench_in.json','rb'),
                       capture_output=True)
    dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    out = p.stdout
    print(f"{mode:9s} wall={dt:6.2f}s cpu={ru.ru_utime:6.2f}s maxrss={ru.ru_maxrss/1024:7.1f}MiB out={len(out)/1e6:.2f}MB rc={p.returncode} err={p.stderr[:100]}")
